get.description: Returns a paginated list of Specification Section Divisions for a Project.

parameters.name: specification_area_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification area.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by specification section division ID.

parameters.name: search_string
parameters.description: Search string to filter divisions by number or description (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: specification_set_ids
parameters.description: Array of specification set IDs to filter divisions by. Use 'none' in the array to include divisions with sections that have no specification set.

parameters.name: with_sections
parameters.description: When set to 'true', returns only divisions that contain at least one non-obsolete specification section.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Blueprint view to render when `no_filter` is provided.

parameters.name: no_filter
parameters.description: When present, returns all divisions without section-based filtering.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

schema.title: SpecificationSectionDivisionV2_1
schema.description: Represents a construction division, which is used to group specification sections. Each SpecificationSectionDivision can contain many SpecificationSections. This version includes a 'deletable' property.

id.description: Unique identifier of the specification section division.

number.description: Division number used to group specification sections.

deletable.description: Indicates if the division can be deleted

sections_ids.description: IDs of the specification sections that belong to this division.

specification_section_revision_ids.description: IDs of the specification section revisions within this division.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.1/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/specification_section_divisions?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&specification_area_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&search_string=SOME_STRING_VALUE&specification_set_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&with_sections=SOME_STRING_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&no_filter=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
